identifier.value: Carbon Credit Certification and Automated Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification (MRV)

product.name: Carbon Credit Certification and Automated Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification (MRV)
product.description: A platform that helps project developers prepare documentation and manage the certification process for carbon credits, including automated monitoring, reporting, and verification to maintain compliance.

product.name: Dynamic Life Cycle Assessment (LCA)
product.description: A tool to rapidly estimate and analyze the life cycle emissions of projects, enabling scenario analysis to optimize project revenue and compliance.

product.name: Tax Credit Compliance and Reporting
product.description: A platform to monitor and simplify compliance with state and federal tax credit requirements, including prevailing wage, apprenticeship, and domestic content rules.

product.name: Project Eligibility Assessment
product.description: A service that scans projects to identify relevant environmental attributes such as carbon credits, tax credits, or supply chain claims based on project specifics.

identifier.value: End-to-End Digital Platform for Carbon Compliance

product.name: End-to-End Digital Platform for Carbon Compliance
product.description: A cloud-based platform that manages the entire carbon credit journey from life cycle assessment setup to monitoring, reporting, and certification submission.
